entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I'm calling about an order, and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I'll certainly do my best to assist. Can you tell me which product you're calling about?
It's the mountain bike shoes I bought about two months ago. I was so excited for them.
Okay, I see the order in your file. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I guess it's preference? I've tried everything, but these specific cycling shoes just aren't working. I can't seem to get the cleats adjusted right, and no matter what socks I wear, they've given me awful blisters on my heels.
Oh, that sounds very uncomfortable. Getting blisters is the last thing we want for our customers. Let me just pull up our return policy and see what we can do for you.
Thank you. I was so worried since it's been a little while. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back... it would help a lot right now.

I completely understand. Let me check... Okay, good news. I see our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You're at about day 60, so you are well within that timeframe. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a huge relief. I was so stressed about it. Thank you so much, Charlie.

Of course. And I can also see here that you're one of our VIP members. To thank you for your loyalty, and for the trouble you've gone through with the shoes, I'm going to email you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. I've also added a $20 credit to your account for your next purchase with us.
Wow, you really didn't have to do that. That's incredibly kind. I'll definitely be shopping again soon then. Thank you!

It's my pleasure. The email with the label is on its way. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and your refund will be issued once we receive them. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help.
Glad I could sort this out for you. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
